name: 079.3 — a gob is one object, and the click belongs to a character
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 079.3: a Gob is interned on the gob id alone, so every character that can see an object finds the same handle and every read answers the same; gob:sessions() reads which of them hold it; and gob:click is retired into session:world():click(gob, button, mods), which refuses without the gob.click key this addon deliberately does not declare.
